)

if [[ $startType -eq "1" ]]
then

	if [ $? -eq 0 ]
		then
        echo "${SERVICE} is running"
	else
	   echo "start ${SERVICE}"
	   sudo systemctl start nmtool_cm_agent

	if [ "$pids" != "" ] 
	then
		echo "${SERVICE} is running"
	else
		source /etc/profile
		systemctl start nmtool_cm_agent
	fi
fi
